parties: <cite index="43-1">NeoGeoInfo Technologies Limited raised $20 million from a Series A fundraise led by Neev Fund II and Aavishkaar India Fund VI</cite>
headline: <cite index="47-3">NeoGeoInfo Technologies raised $20 million via primary subscription to compulsorily convertible preference shares and equity shares</cite>
sum: Gurugram geospatial startup NeoGeoInfo closes $20M Series A from SBI-backed Neev Fund II and Aavishkaar Capital. This is the first institutional funding round for the Company and will allow it to further expand into international markets, while continuing to contribute to the role of geospatial data in governance, infrastructure development, and disaster management in India.
implication: First institutional capital for pre-Series A bootstrapped geospatial tech firm; co-lead structure (SBI + impact investor) signals impact-thesis alignment on climate-resilient infrastructure and government digitisation; equity/CCPS hybrid structure typical for growth-stage climate-tech rounds in India.
detail: <cite index="25-5,25-6">The company operates across the full geospatial value chain from data acquisition using satellite imagery, LiDAR, drones, and ground surveys, to data processing, AI/ML-driven analytics, and creation of tech-enabled industry-specific software platforms, and has built a portfolio of proprietary platforms including OptiFleet (fleet and network optimisation), GeoBalance (natural resource management), UrbanVista (urban planning and smart city visualisation), and InfraSync (infrastructure asset management).</cite> <cite index="41-7">NeoGeo will split the capital equally across three priorities: deepening its India lead, funding international offices, and building software products.</cite> <cite index="21-11">India has sought to increase private-sector participation in the geospatial industry through the National Geospatial Policy 2022, which liberalised access to geospatial data and encouraged businesses to develop new applications and services.</cite>
